change_log.value: Brain Lock Schema and TTL Contract Definition

GOV-F-003-S117.title: Brain Lock Schema and TTL Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S117.description: Define the Brain lock document schema including lock_id, owner_id, acquired_at, expires_at (TTL), and status. Establish TTL index behavior and ownership contract rules (single owner, expiration semantics, renewal window). Ensure compatibility with MongoDB TTL indexing and existing Brain persistence patterns.

GOV-F-003-S118.title: Brain Lock Management API (Acquire/Renew/Release)
GOV-F-003-S118.description: Implement backend service interfaces for lock acquisition, renewal (TTL extension), and release. Enforce ownership validation on renew/release and reject invalid or stale lock operations. Provide atomic operations to prevent race conditions.
